1 REM by Frank Eggen 2025
2 REM -------------------
3 REM
10 REM ENTERPRISE WITH 7 LEDs
20 POKE $E4,0: REM LED SPEED 0
30 REM READ BUFFER DATA
100 FOR I=1 TO 32 STEP +1
110 READ A
120 POKE $02c0+I-1,A
130 PRINT A;
140 NEXT I
150 POKE $E4,60: REM LED SPEED 60
160 END
200 REM 32 Bytes LED-Buffer
